description: The pie chart illustrates a two-part breakdown comparing time durations and their corresponding percentages for two distinct categories. The chart consists of exactly two slices. The larger segment, colored orange, is labeled "Reduction" and accounts for 60.9s, which corresponds to 69.92% of the total. The smaller segment, colored blue, is labeled "Efficient deployment" and represents 26.2s, or 30.08%. The chart does not feature a separate legend; rather, the category names are positioned just outside their respective slices, while the exact time values and percentages (enclosed in parentheses) are displayed directly inside the segments. Visually, the blue "Efficient deployment" slice is emphasized by being exploded, or slightly offset, from the larger orange slice.
